method: Two actual installed Claude CLI calls with tools disabled; evidence supplied by Codex. No independent Claude browsing.

rounds.purpose: Challenge legal/photo assumptions, buyer value, maintenance costs and proposed priorities.
Correct overclaims and reassess using newly found merchant policy, template, image-license and public-agency evidence.

accepted: Prioritize an audit of unsupported guide claims, then common-format evidence cards for the four known official merchants.
Keep missing fields visibly unknown; provide neutral EN/ES buyer questions and a printable visit/quote worksheet.
Photos can assist entrance identification; relative value versus purchase information is not validated.
Use official gallery links while evaluating rights-cleared original images. Commons example is historical district context only, pending visual review.
Do not scale to all 191 registrations or build a generic comparison engine on the present evidence.
Treat California Balloon House refund information as a new draft candidate; hold Tom's Model template-like policy and outdated shipping notice.
If later content changes are deployed, record deployment date and affected pages so observation is interpreted correctly.
corrected_or_rejected: Not all Street View copyright belongs to Google; policy and contract restrictions are not a blanket legal ruling.
A facade photo is not proof of a currently operating merchant, stock, ownership, safety or accessibility.
Dated online facade photos can exist; identity, date and license still require separate checks.
GSC is unavailable; a low query-impression share is not evidence of absent buyer demand. No 5-percent gate.
Product-specific non-Google-map exceptions exist; API support still does not establish permission for this directory's integration.
Failed retrieval is unavailable, a field not found within scope is not_found_in_review, and contradictory sources are conflict. No inference of absent service.
Claude's publication recommendations do not mean the current research request implemented or published anything.
The 28-day observation window is October 15 through November 11; December 1 is the separate final decision date.
additional_codex_research_after_round2: CPSC official recall API and seller guidance are additional buyer-resource candidates, not items independently reviewed or endorsed in the two Claude rounds.
implementation_status: Research notes and drafts only. No web or pipeline data changes, outreach, image acquisition, API activation, deployment, commit or push.
